Product received as a result of heating process with some additional substances. Subjected by heating and additional substances.  Product characteristics:   A ready to consumption product or confectionery semi-product, filling. Product contains at least 85% of apples of preserved dice shape, colour yellow, gold, characteristic for used type of apples, sour-sweet taste, flavour characteristic for apples, without any strange tastes or flavours. Thick consistence, gelled. Packed in buckets.  Net weight:   6 or 11 kg   Gross weight : 6,50 or 11,50kg  Ingredients:     Apples 85%,     Water,     Sugar,     Modified starch E-1442 (thickening substance) ,     Citric acid E-330 (acidity regulator),     Potassium sorbate E-202 (preservative),     Sodium benzoate E-211 (preservative),     Vitaminum C,     β-carotene pigment,     Sodium pyrosulfite E-223 (antioxidant).  Made of : minimum 85g of fruits per 100g of product  Chemical characteristics of the product:  - content of organic pollutants – not more than 0.1%, - extract content is marked with refractometric method, not less than 20%, - acidity is marked with pehametric method, pH 2.5 - 4.0, - content of metals detrimental to health, not more than (mg/kg):     sulfur dioxide and sulfites in concentrations below 50mg/kg converting per sulfur dioxide,     patulin below level 25μg/kg,     cadmium at highest permissible level below 0.05 mg/kg,     lead at highest permissible level below 0.1 mg/kg.  Microbiological characteristics:   Absence of Salmonella and Listeria monocytogenes. E.coli - permissible level below 100ufc/g. Presence of pests is inadmissible, any signs of mould or fermentation are inadmissible.
